Package dev.px.core.account

Class AccountService

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.account.AccountService
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigSection, Named, Service
public final class AccountService extends Object implements Service, ConfigSection
The saved accounts and the login flow.

Logins run on the thread pool, because the OAuth exchange blocks for seconds and doing it on the game thread freezes the client. The callback is handed back for the caller to marshal onto the game thread, since only the caller knows how its UI wants to be updated.

Applying the session is the one part that must happen on the game thread, so login(dev.px.core.account.Account, java.util.function.Consumer<dev.px.core.account.AuthResult>) does not do it: it returns the result and the caller applies it through applySession(dev.px.core.account.Session) from wherever is safe.

      public void login(Account account, Consumer<AuthResult> callback)
      Authenticates an account off the game thread.

      The callback runs on a worker thread. Marshal to the game thread before touching any game state, and call applySession(dev.px.core.account.Session) from there.
